# Test what happens when main() is called with no args
import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(['python', '-c', 'from semver import main; main([])'], capture_output=True, text=True)
print("STDOUT:", result.stdout[:500])
print("STDERR:", result.stderr[:500])
print("Return code:", result.returncode)
